notes: v4.2: Factory-reset ki pabandi ab POORE plan ke doran rehti hai (jab tak qist/paisa baqi hai) — pehle ye sirf 3 din ki mohlat (grace) guzarne ke baad lagti thi, jis se mohlat ke andar reset ho jata tha (Tecno test 21 Oct me pakra gaya). Mohlat ab sirf lock par hai, reset-block par nahi. FRP bhi sakht: shop Google account ab Android ki apni Factory Reset Protection policy se bhi bandha gaya hai. Baqi v4.1 wale features (Shop Email, IMEI khana, barcode scan) shamil.
